message:
Joanna, I've taken your suggestion, in a way: I've used the mid-semester evals to put together the [Essay 4](/weblog/archives/2005/11/23/601/) assignment. The "wild card" thing would have been unmanageable in terms of evaluative criteria, but I think I've managed to combine 80% of my students' course eval suggestions into something that looks like a workable essay assignment. But, yes, they're a little apprehensive.

And that negative filter suggestion is brilliant. That's gonna be something that gets them started when they don't know how to revise.

I'd love to hear any feedback you might offer on the remix assignment.
